description: This file defines the EmploymentStatus entity class used within the OrangeHRM project. It models the employment status data, including properties like id and name, and manages a collection of associated Employee entities. The class uses Doctrine ORM annotations to map the class to the database table 'ohrm_employment_status'.

classes.name: EmploymentStatus
classes.description: Entity class representing employment status entries, including properties for id, name, and associated employees, with ORM annotations for database mapping.

methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the employment status.

methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the employment status.

methods.description: Returns the name of the employment status.

methods.description: Returns the collection of employees associated with this employment status.
